Title: Public preview: Oracle to Azure migration with Database Migration Assessment for Oracle

Body.Content:
Expanded capabilities within the Database Migration Assessment for Oracle extension in Azure Data Studio now include Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The extension allows you to perform code assessment (identify complexity of workload), estimate the manual effort required to migrate the workload to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and provides a detailed report with actions needed to facilitate the migration. This extension provides a way to plan your migration from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, removing the tedious work of assessing the migration manually.

Review the documentation and read the Tech Community blog.
